_readme: Ground truth for comparing candidate reasoning models (Apple Foundation
Models vs mere.run vs OpenAI). Every value here was read off the real OCR
output of the named scan - nothing is invented. Verify against:
The two cases are deliberately opposed: 000524 requires NOTHING of the
recipient, 007969 carries a real obligation plus a relative deadline. A
model that invents obligations fails the first; one that misses them fails
the second. Scoring both prevents tuning to one shape.

epa-524-529.notes: Notification acknowledgement. EPA is confirming receipt. Nothing is required.

invented_obligation.why: There is no deadline and nothing to submit. A model that manufactures one is unsafe for this product.

receipt_date_as_letter_date.why: 'EPA Receipt Date: 08/30/2024' is not the date of the letter.

epa-7969-242.notes: Label amendment approval. Carries an obligation AND an 18-month relative deadline.

wrong_deadline_anchor.why: The 18 months runs from the LETTER date (2017-01-11), not the Application Date (2015-10-22). Anchoring to the wrong date is the single most dangerous error on this page.

silent_arithmetic.why: Deriving a date is fine; deriving it WITHOUT saying it was derived is not. It must be marked as computed, not quoted.
require_one_of: from the date of this letter
